about: Stage 6 transfer probe. 60 delegation briefs written by hand in the style an orchestrator writes to a sub-agent, each with an a-priori band (easy / medium / hard) recorded before any model scored them. No model outcomes exist for these briefs: this is a sanity probe of how a trained model ranks realistic briefs, not evidence of solved rate. Do not edit the bands after looking at model output.

band_meaning.easy: a cheap model should do it: one obvious, local, mechanical change
band_meaning.medium: a bounded change in one area that needs reading code and some judgement, or a small feature with tests
band_meaning.hard: multi-file or cross-component design, concurrency, migration, or a diagnosis with an unknown cause

briefs.brief: The docstring of parse_date says it returns a string; it returns a datetime. Correct the docstring.

briefs.brief: Add a constant MAX_RETRIES = 3 to src/constants.ts next to the other limits.

briefs.title: Change an error message
briefs.brief: Change the error message 'invalid input' to 'invalid input: expected a number' in validate.go.

briefs.title: Sort a list
briefs.brief: Sort the list of supported languages in languages.json alphabetically.

briefs.title: Delete a dead file
briefs.brief: Delete the file src/legacy/old_helpers.js; nothing imports it.

briefs.title: Add a type annotation
briefs.brief: Add the return type annotation -> int to the function count_items in stats.py.

briefs.title: Toggle a feature flag
briefs.brief: Set enable_beta_search to false in flags.yaml.

briefs.title: Fix indentation
briefs.brief: Fix the indentation of the else branch in handlers/user.py so it lines up with its if.

briefs.title: Add a changelog entry
briefs.brief: Add a changelog line under 'Unreleased': 'Fixed the typo in the settings page'.

briefs.title: Add input validation
briefs.brief: Add validation to the POST /users handler: reject an email without '@' and a name longer than 100 characters with a 400 and a clear message. Add tests for both cases.

briefs.title: Fix off-by-one in pagination
briefs.brief: The last page of the orders list is missing one item when the total is a multiple of the page size. Find the off-by-one in the pagination helper and fix it; add a regression test.

briefs.title: Write unit tests
briefs.brief: Write unit tests for the slugify function in text/slug.ts covering unicode, repeated separators and empty input. Do not change the function unless a test shows a real bug.

briefs.title: Add a CLI flag
briefs.brief: Add a --dry-run flag to the export command: it prints what would be written and writes nothing. Wire it through the argument parser and document it in the command's help.

briefs.title: Extract a helper
briefs.brief: The date formatting code is duplicated in three components under src/components/. Extract it into one helper in src/lib/date.ts and use it in all three; keep the output identical.

briefs.title: Debounce search input
briefs.brief: The search box fires a request on every keystroke. Debounce it by 300 ms and cancel the previous request when a new one starts.

briefs.title: Fix a failing test
briefs.brief: test_invoice_totals fails after the currency rounding change. Find out whether the test or the code is wrong and fix the right one; explain which in your answer.

briefs.title: Add an index
briefs.brief: Queries on orders by customer_id and created_at are slow. Add a migration that creates a composite index and make sure the migration runs both up and down.

briefs.title: Implement retry with backoff
briefs.brief: Wrap the HTTP client's send in a retry with exponential backoff (3 attempts, 200 ms base, jitter) for 502/503/504 and connection errors only. Add a test with a fake server.

briefs.title: Dark mode for a page
briefs.brief: The billing page ignores dark mode. Replace its hard-coded colours with the theme tokens used elsewhere in the app.

briefs.title: Parse a new config field
briefs.brief: Add an optional `timeout_ms` field to the [upstream] section of the config: parse it, default to 30000, reject values below 100, and use it in the client.

briefs.title: Fix a memory leak in a component
briefs.brief: The dashboard leaks an interval when the user leaves the page. Find where the interval is created and clear it on unmount; check the other widgets for the same mistake.

briefs.title: CSV export endpoint
briefs.brief: Add GET /reports/{id}/export.csv that streams the report rows as CSV with a header row, proper quoting and a Content-Disposition filename.

briefs.title: Upgrade a dependency
briefs.brief: Upgrade the yaml library from 5.x to 6.x, fix the call sites that break (safe_load signature changed), and run the test suite.

briefs.title: Keyboard shortcut
briefs.brief: Add a Ctrl+K shortcut that focuses the command palette, without breaking Ctrl+K inside the code editor.

briefs.title: Handle empty state
briefs.brief: When a project has no files the file tree shows a spinner forever. Show an empty-state message instead and add a test for it.

briefs.title: Translate error codes
briefs.brief: Map the storage layer's error codes to user-facing messages in the API layer; unknown codes fall back to a generic message and are logged.

briefs.title: Make a function async
briefs.brief: load_profile reads the file synchronously and blocks the event loop. Make it async and update its four callers.

briefs.title: Add a GitHub Actions job
briefs.brief: Add a CI job that runs the linter on pull requests, caches dependencies, and fails on warnings.

briefs.title: Fix timezone bug
briefs.brief: Reminders scheduled for 09:00 fire at 08:00 for users in Europe after the DST change. Fix the scheduling to use the user's timezone and add a test across a DST boundary.

briefs.title: Optimistic concurrency for sync
briefs.brief: Design and implement optimistic concurrency for the sync queue across client and server, with migration: version every record, reject stale writes with a conflict the client can merge, migrate existing rows, and cover concurrent edits from two devices in tests.

briefs.title: Find a race condition
briefs.brief: Under load the job runner sometimes runs a job twice. Find the race (it is not reproducible locally with one worker), fix it so each job runs at most once across workers, and add a stress test that would have caught it.

briefs.title: Plugin system
briefs.brief: Introduce a plugin system for exporters: a stable interface, discovery from a plugins directory, versioning, isolation of a failing plugin, and port the three built-in exporters to it without changing their output.

briefs.title: Incremental indexing
briefs.brief: Replace the full re-index on every file save with incremental indexing: track file hashes, update only changed symbols, handle renames and deletions, and keep queries consistent while an update is in progress.

briefs.title: Multi-tenant isolation
briefs.brief: Make the API multi-tenant: every table gets a tenant id, every query is scoped by it, add row-level checks in the data layer, migrate existing data into a default tenant, and prove with tests that one tenant cannot read another's rows.

briefs.title: Diagnose a production crash
briefs.brief: The service crashes about once a day with a segfault in the native image library; core dumps are attached in /tmp/cores. Find the cause, decide whether to patch, pin or replace the library, and implement the fix.

briefs.title: Offline mode
briefs.brief: Add offline support to the mobile client: queue mutations locally, replay them on reconnect in order, resolve conflicts with the server's state, and show the user what is pending.

briefs.title: Streaming parser rewrite
briefs.brief: The JSON log parser loads whole files into memory and dies on 2 GB logs. Rewrite it as a streaming parser with bounded memory, keep the public API, and benchmark it against the old one.

briefs.title: Distributed rate limiter
briefs.brief: Replace the in-process rate limiter with one shared across instances (Redis), with a sliding window, per-key limits from config, graceful behaviour when Redis is down, and tests with several instances.

briefs.title: Undo/redo for the editor
briefs.brief: Implement undo/redo for the diagram editor covering every mutation (move, resize, connect, delete, group), merging consecutive drags into one step, and keeping it consistent with collaborative edits from other users.

briefs.title: Schema migration with zero downtime
briefs.brief: Split the users.name column into first_name and last_name with zero downtime: expand, backfill in batches, dual-write, switch reads, contract. Write each step as a separate migration and a runbook.

briefs.title: Port the build to a new toolchain
briefs.brief: Move the monorepo build from webpack to vite across all five packages, keep code splitting and the bundle budget, fix the import cycles that the new bundler rejects, and make CI green.

briefs.title: Flaky end-to-end tests
briefs.brief: About a third of the end-to-end runs fail at random in different places. Find the shared cause or causes (timing, test isolation, shared state), fix them at the root rather than adding retries, and show ten green runs in a row.

briefs.title: Permission model
briefs.brief: Design a role-based permission model for projects (owner, editor, viewer, custom roles), enforce it in every API route and in the UI, migrate current users, and add tests for each route and role.

briefs.title: Query planner bug
briefs.brief: Some queries with nested OR filters return wrong rows after the planner optimisation landed. Find which rewrite rule is unsound, prove it with a minimal failing case, fix the rule and add property-based tests for the rewrites.

briefs.title: End-to-end encryption
briefs.brief: Add end-to-end encryption to shared notes: key generation per device, key sharing between a user's devices, encrypting existing notes on upgrade, and key rotation when a device is removed.

briefs.title: Memory growth over days
briefs.brief: The server's memory grows slowly for days until it is killed. Profile it, find what is retained, fix the leak and add a soak test that would show regrowth.

briefs.title: Event sourcing for orders
briefs.brief: Move the orders module to event sourcing: define events, rebuild current state from them, write projections for the three read models, migrate existing orders into events, and keep the HTTP API unchanged.

briefs.title: Cross-platform file watcher
briefs.brief: Our file watcher misses changes on macOS and floods events on Linux. Replace it with a cross-platform design that coalesces events, handles renames and symlinks, and survives the watched directory being deleted and recreated.

briefs.title: Deadlock in the scheduler
briefs.brief: Two scheduler threads occasionally deadlock when a job is cancelled while it is being rescheduled. Find the lock ordering problem across scheduler.rs, queue.rs and worker.rs, redesign the locking, and add a test that reproduces the interleaving.
